# `π` — Pi

`πY`: πY. Pervasive.

```apl
π1                ⍝ 3.141592653589793
π2                ⍝ 6.283185307179586
```

`XπY`: Xπ/Y. Angles in radians.

```apl
1π2               ⍝ 1.5707963267948966
2π3               ⍝ 2.0943951023931953
```

Use [`○`](circle.qmd) to turn an angle into a unit-circle point.
